newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: GPA Group says Q3 net profit $12 mln.
newsitem.headline: GPA Group says Q3 net profit $12 mln.

text.p: GPA Group Plc said it made an unaudited net profit of $12 million for the quarter ended December 31, 1996 after exceptional costs of $9 million.
This compared with a net loss of $9 million in the same quarter of 1995 after exceptional costs of $7 million, GPA said in a statement.
Revenue in the quarter was $118 million against $240 million a year earlier while net interest expense and cashflow amounted to $0.4 million and $71 million respectively.
This was down from $82 million and $158 million respectively in 1995 and resulted from the sale of 229 aircraft to Airplans Group in March 1996.
Commenting on the results, GPA chief executive Neil Blaney said the group's earnings reflected market conditions generally and the impact of lower borrowings.
"In particular, during the quarter, the underlying debt in respect of eight A320 aircraft subject to U.S. leverage leases was refinanced," Blaney said.
Shareholders' funds at end-1996 amounted to $202 million with borrowings of $781 million, a reduction of $794 million compared with March 31, 1996.
